# Audette IT

> Personal IT help for family and friends, run by one person: everyday troubleshooting plus real infrastructure work (network design, Active Directory, self-hosted services, security hardening). Not a registered business. The site is currently under maintenance. Contact: michael.audette@audetteit.com

The homepage has a Markdown version at `/index.md`, or request `/` with an `Accept: text/markdown` header.

- [Home](https://audetteit.com/index.md): Maintenance notice (the full site is being rebuilt)
